items.content_text:
### Development / Devops

*   [logdy (⭐1.9k)](https://github.com/logdyhq/logdy-core) - Supercharge terminal logs with web UI.

### Development / HTTP Client

*   [ATAC (⭐2.9k)](https://github.com/Julien-cpsn/ATAC) - A feature-full TUI API client made in Rust.

### Files and Directories / File Managers

*   [xplr (⭐4.5k)](https://github.com/sayanarijit/xplr) - A hackable, minimal, fast TUI file explorer.

### Files and Directories / Disk Usage

*   [duf (⭐14k)](https://github.com/muesli/duf) - A better `df` alternative.
*   [dust (⭐10k)](https://github.com/bootandy/dust) - A more intuitive version of `du` in Rust.
*   [dutree (⭐851)](https://github.com/nachoparker/dutree) - A tool to analyze file system usage written in Rust.

### Files and Directories / Files

*   [f2 (⭐2.2k)](https://github.com/ayoisaiah/f2) - A cross-platform tool for fast, safe, and flexible batch renaming.

### Files and Directories / Search

*   [television (⭐3.3k)](https://github.com/alexpasmantier/television) - A very fast general purpose fuzzy finder.

### Version Control / Git

*   [bash-git-prompt (⭐6.8k)](https://github.com/magicmonty/bash-git-prompt) - Informative and fancy bash prompt for Git users.
*   [gitui (⭐20k)](https://github.com/extrawurst/gitui) - Blazing fast terminal-ui for git written in Rust.
